meta.name: Storyloom AI Presentation
meta.foundation: Storyloom Design System (Storyloom palette tokens, type, icons, photography rules)
meta.canvas: 16:9 widescreen, 13.333 x 7.5 in (1280 x 720 px design canvas)

workflow.name: User intent
workflow.desc: Owner shares objective, audience, context, data, research, quotes, screenshots.

workflow.name: AI understanding
workflow.desc: Why, for whom, what decision, what evidence exists, level of detail.

workflow.name: Story strategy
workflow.desc: Pick a presentation type and story structure; draft the narrative.

workflow.name: Story approval
workflow.desc: Story Proposal goes to the owner. Only an explicit approval unlocks the next step. Silence, partial feedback or implied approval is not approval.

workflow.name: Presentation blueprint
workflow.desc: Map every approved slide to template, component, visualization, asset and representation IDs.

workflow.name: Governed assembly
workflow.desc: Build the .pptx from approved elements only.

workflow.name: Governance check
workflow.desc: Story, design, assets, visualization, content and PowerPoint QC.

workflow.name: Final human review
workflow.desc: Owner reviews, edits and signs off the deck.

workflow.name: Final presentation
workflow.desc: Downloadable .pptx with name, slide count, story used, exceptions and gaps.

gate2.name: Governance exception
gate2.desc: Raised at any step when a needed element is missing or Restricted. Assembly of that element pauses until a human approves or substitutes.

governanceLevels.name: Conditional
governanceLevels.rule: AI may use it only when the stated condition is met.

governanceLevels.name: Restricted
governanceLevels.rule: Needs human approval for each use. Proposed drafts start here.

governanceLevels.name: Missing
governanceLevels.rule: Needed but not in the library. AI flags it (GATE-02) and never improvises it.

hierarchy.name: Similar approved pattern
hierarchy.action: Adapt the closest one without changing its visual language.

hierarchy.name: Nothing approved exists
hierarchy.action: Flag the gap and request approval (GATE-02).

presentationTypes.name: Performance Readout
presentationTypes.purpose: Communicate performance, progress, outcomes and key business or CX metrics.

presentationTypes.name: Experiment Readout
presentationTypes.purpose: Take an experiment from hypothesis through outcome and learning.

presentationTypes.name: Campaign / Concept
presentationTypes.purpose: Present a CX concept, campaign, creative direction or new experience.

presentationTypes.name: Journey Presentation
presentationTypes.purpose: Show a customer journey, its pain points, opportunities and future state.

storyStructures.name: Default CX narrative
storyStructures.when: Default when no type-specific structure fits better.

storyStructures.name: Executive answer-first
storyStructures.when: Only for executive audiences with 5 slides or fewer.

slideTemplates.name: Title
slideTemplates.purpose: Open the deck: title, subtitle, date, owner.

slideTemplates.name: Section divider
slideTemplates.purpose: Mark a story chapter in decks of 10+ slides.

slideTemplates.name: Executive summary
slideTemplates.purpose: Headline plus three supporting points and the ask.

slideTemplates.name: Big statement
slideTemplates.purpose: One hypothesis, insight or principle, stated large.

slideTemplates.name: KPI grid
slideTemplates.purpose: Three or four headline metrics at a glance.

slideTemplates.name: KPI + trend
slideTemplates.purpose: One metric, its movement over time and what it means.

slideTemplates.name: Chart focus
slideTemplates.purpose: A single chart with takeaway headline and annotation.

slideTemplates.name: Insight + evidence
slideTemplates.purpose: Lead with the insight; evidence cards support it.

slideTemplates.name: Customer voice
slideTemplates.purpose: One to three verbatim quotes around a theme.

slideTemplates.name: Customer / persona
slideTemplates.purpose: Who the audience is: needs, behaviors, context.

slideTemplates.name: Two column
slideTemplates.purpose: Pair a message with its evidence, or two related ideas.

slideTemplates.name: Three column
slideTemplates.condition: Exactly three parallel items, each 40 words or fewer.
slideTemplates.purpose: Drivers, learnings, principles or opportunities.

slideTemplates.name: Before / after
slideTemplates.purpose: Current vs. redesigned experience or metric.

slideTemplates.name: Experiment variants
slideTemplates.purpose: Control vs. variant(s) with screens and results.

slideTemplates.name: Journey map
slideTemplates.purpose: Stages with actions, emotions, pain points, opportunities.

slideTemplates.name: Process / design
slideTemplates.purpose: Sequential steps such as experiment setup or a service flow.

slideTemplates.name: Timeline / roadmap
slideTemplates.purpose: Dated milestones or phased rollout.

slideTemplates.name: Priority matrix
slideTemplates.purpose: Opportunities placed by impact and effort.

slideTemplates.name: Device hero
slideTemplates.purpose: One product screen in an approved frame, with 2 to 3 callouts.

slideTemplates.name: Cross-device
slideTemplates.purpose: The same experience on phone, tablet and laptop.

slideTemplates.name: Messaging touchpoint
slideTemplates.condition: Depends on MSG-* patterns that are still proposed.
slideTemplates.purpose: SMS, RCS or notification moments in a journey.

slideTemplates.name: Recommendations
slideTemplates.purpose: Two to four actions, each tied to evidence.

slideTemplates.name: Next steps
slideTemplates.purpose: Owner, action and date for each step.

slideTemplates.name: Bullet list
slideTemplates.purpose: Up to 6 short bullets when cards or columns do not fit the content.

components.name: Title block
components.use: Slide headline stated as the takeaway, plus optional kicker.

components.name: Section header
components.use: Chapter number and name on a Deep navy ground.

components.name: Text block
components.use: Short paragraph, 60 words max.

components.name: 2-column layout
components.use: Message + evidence, or two parallel ideas.

components.name: 3-column layout
components.use: Exactly three parallel items.

components.name: Callout
components.use: Annotate a chart or screen with one takeaway.

components.name: KPI card
components.use: One headline number, label and period.

components.name: Metric card + delta
components.use: Number with change vs. baseline, icon and word for direction.

components.name: Comparison table
components.use: 5+ records across the same attributes.

components.name: Insight card
components.use: One finding with its implication.

components.name: Quote card
components.use: Verbatim quote with attributed segment, never invented.

components.name: Evidence card
components.use: Source, method and sample size behind a claim.

components.name: Customer card
components.use: Segment, context and top need.

components.name: Persona block
components.use: Only when a research-backed persona exists.

components.name: Image block
components.use: Photography: black and white, 16:9, 4:3, 3:4 or 1:1.

components.name: Screenshot frame
components.use: Real product capture placed inside an approved DEVICE-* frame.

components.name: Journey map
components.use: Stages across; actions, feelings, pains, opportunities down.

components.name: Process diagram
components.use: 3 to 6 sequential steps.

components.name: Flow diagram
components.use: Branching logic, 8 nodes max.

components.name: Timeline
components.use: Dated milestones, left to right.

components.name: Before / after
components.use: Same frame, same scale, left = before.

components.name: Recommendation block
components.use: Action, rationale, evidence link.

components.name: Next-step block
components.use: Action, owner, date.

components.name: Concept card
components.use: Concept name, one-line idea, key visual.

components.name: Bullet list
components.use: Up to 6 short bullets. Prefer insight cards when each point needs its own evidence.

visualizations.name: Comparison
visualizations.meaning: Two or three things side by side.

visualizations.name: Distribution
visualizations.meaning: Spread of values. Needs 30+ data points.

visualizations.name: Before / after
visualizations.meaning: Change from one state to another.

visualizations.name: Pie / donut
visualizations.meaning: Part-to-whole with 2 to 5 slices that add up to 100%.

devices.name: iPhone (notch)
devices.note: Only when the capture came from a notch-era device. Never mix with IPHONE-01 on one slide.

devices.name: Browser window
devices.note: Web screens and web apps. Transparent content area; the screenshot sits behind the frame.

devices.name: Desktop monitor
devices.note: Drafted from Storyloom Design System tokens. Needs approval before use.

deviceRules: Screens sit behind the frame, filling the measured screen area exactly. Never scale a frame non-proportionally.
One frame family per slide. Same product on several slides: same frame every time.
Front-facing only. No added perspective, tilt or extra shadow unless the frame file carries it.
Real screenshots only. Do not redraw product UI inside a frame.

assetHousekeeping.note: Unnamed duplicate of A-DEV-LAPTOP-01. Rename or remove.
Non-transparent variant. Use only on white slides.
Source files with baked shadow. Not for direct placement.

messaging.name: iOS Messages (iMessage)
messaging.note: Blue outgoing bubbles, contact header, timestamp, delivered state.

messaging.name: SMS on iOS
messaging.note: Green bubbles and 'Text Message' label, the native SMS cue.

messaging.name: RCS business message
messaging.note: Verified sender, rich card, suggested replies. Shown on DEVICE-IPHONE-02.

messaging.name: Lock-screen notification
messaging.note: Stacked notifications over a neutral lock screen.

messagingRules: Native platform colors (bubble blue, SMS green, system grey) are allowed inside MSG-* only. Everything around them uses Storyloom Design System tokens.
Brand name, sender and message copy come from the owner. Never invent regulated or clinical wording.
Time reads 9:41. No real phone numbers or personal data.

icons.library: Lucide (outline, filled and rounded; rounded is the default)
icons.rules: 24px grid, stroke 1.75, currentColor, sizes 16 / 20 / 24 / 32. Never the only carrier of meaning. No other icon sets. IDs are ICN- plus the Lucide name; the 18 core CX icons keep their short IDs.

variants.name: Outline
variants.rule: Lucide outline, stroke 1.75, currentColor. Use inline: inside pills, badges, table cells and small labels.

variants.name: Rounded
variants.rule: Default on slides and templates. Icon centered on a 40px tile with radius-lg (12), color-state-selected-bg fill, icon in color-action-primary-bg.

variants.name: Rounded solid
variants.rule: Same tile filled with color-action-primary-bg, icon in color-action-primary-text. Use for one emphasis point per slide.

categories.name: Status & insights
items: Same glyph as ICN-CIRCLE-ALERT (older Lucide name)

assetGroups.name: Brand and logos
assetGroups.note: The design system ships no logo. Product name is set in plain type until a mark is supplied.

assetGroups.name: Device frames
assetGroups.note: 6 approved PNGs with transparent screens (5 devices + browser window).

assetGroups.name: Photography
assetGroups.note: Rule: black and white only. No photo library yet, owner supplies images.

assetGroups.name: Product screenshots
assetGroups.note: Supplied per project. Must be real captures, never mocked up.

assetGroups.name: Backgrounds
assetGroups.note: Design system surfaces only: background, subtle, sunken, inverse, primary.

assetGroups.name: Decorative elements
assetGroups.note: None approved. Do not add ornament.

colors: Deep navy: title and section grounds
Pale lavender: one highlight per slide
tokens.spacing: 4px scale: space-1 4 ... space-11 96. Slide margin 72 px (0.75 in). Card padding 40 px (0.4 in). Gaps between cards 28 px (0.3 in). Slide content sits between 1.85 in and 6.3 in, so there is always air above the source line and footer.
tokens.radius: radius-md 8 (callouts), radius-lg 12 (cards). Device frames keep their own radius.

storyRules: Lead with the insight, not the artifact.
Every claim is backed by evidence on the slide.
Cut slides that exist only to fill a template.
Never repeat the same information on two slides.
Progress context, understanding, evidence, implication, action.
Use a visual when it communicates faster than text.
Use a chart only when it reveals a meaningful pattern.
Keep hierarchy, spacing, type and visual language consistent.
Use the same approved representation for the same thing throughout.
Show native experiences with their approved pattern, never a generic placeholder.
Visual design never changes the approved story.

gaps.impact: Title and closing slides use plain type.
Owner supplies B&W photos per deck.
No master yet. Decks are built programmatically from tokens, following the layouts in the lorem-ipsum template decks (templates/).
